submission.natural_language_explanation: The direction fires on a token that, in its context, is an unfinished fragment of a longer multi-token word, so the next token must continue the same word without a space: typically a short capitalised or all-caps word-start of a rare proper name, acronym or identifier (' U'+'vira', ' Sh'+'imer', ' Al'+'-Khilafah', ' SC'+'IENT', ' TO'+'OLS' after 'DIGGING FOR', 'my'+'of'+'ibroblasts', '_DIRECT'+'ED'), and most strongly when the fragment could otherwise be read as a complete word or letter. It stays near zero on tokens that complete a word by themselves (' Alabama', ' Harvard', ' US', ' GOLD', ' BONES') and on ordinary prose.
